name: DashCore Native Renderer Diagnostics
description: Android renderer research and diagnostics: process memory visibility plus opt-in GLES compute and asynchronous SSBO transfer tests. Preserves the original Cocos renderer.

capture-object-diagnostics.name: Capture object diagnostics
capture-object-diagnostics.description: Enables optional per-frame read-only CPU inspection of level objects for diagnostics. Disabled by default; no custom renderer or OpenGL calls are used.

gles-compute-diagnostic-probe.name: Run GLES compute diagnostic probe
gles-compute-diagnostic-probe.description: Runs one tiny 4-value GLES 3.1 compute/SSBO self-test during gameplay. Diagnostic only; disabled by default and does not draw or process level objects.

gles-dynamic-ssbo-diagnostic-probe.name: Run GLES dynamic SSBO transfer probe
gles-dynamic-ssbo-diagnostic-probe.description: Runs a one-shot GLES 3.1 test that reallocates two tiny SSBOs, uploads CPU data, dispatches Compute, and validates readback. Disabled by default; does not draw or process level objects.

gles-ssbo-transfer-benchmark.name: Run legacy synchronous GLES SSBO benchmark
gles-ssbo-transfer-benchmark.description: Legacy blocking comparison at 1, 4, 16, and 64 KiB per SSBO. Can stall while reading GPU output; disabled by default and automatically skipped when the asynchronous benchmark is enabled.

gles-ssbo-async-transfer-benchmark.name: Run asynchronous GLES SSBO benchmark
gles-ssbo-async-transfer-benchmark.description: Runs a bounded 1, 4, 16, and 64 KiB SSBO test over multiple gameplay frames. Uses GLsync with zero-timeout polling and reads back only after the fence signals. Shader compilation and bounded allocations still occur; disabled by default and does not draw or process level objects.
